aboutH2: Victoria Wellness: Residential Mental Health and Addiction Care on Rice Lake
intro: Victoria Wellness focuses on addiction and mental wellness with a wide range of treatment tools. This includes both 12-Step and other non-12-Step modalities. They also use holistic and non-traditional methods like neurofeedback, ketamine assisted treatment, and dolphin neurostim. Every client’s treatment plan is tailored to their individual needs. This includes input from Victoria Wellness’ clinical staff as well as clients’ past experiences with trauma, addiction or mental illness. Clients receive the best, most comprehensive care, which ultimately leads to lasting recovery.

pillars.title: Amazing Staff, Designed To Lasting Recovery
pillars.body: Victoria Wellness Residential Mental Health Center has highly qualified staff. Their psychologist and psychiatrist are professional and compassionate. They ensure that every client’s needs are met. There are several masters-level psychotherapists on staff, as well as a social worker and addiction counsellor, two mental health nurses, and a list of recovery coaches. Victoria Wellness Centre has a staff that is available to assist clients in their recovery and provides a complete service. A registered therapist runs all psychotherapy sessions such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, DBT and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy. Individual sessions at Victoria Wellness are conducted by a psychotherapist who acts as the primary therapist for clients throughout their treatment.

pillars.title: Recovery Skills and Habits: Building Habits
pillars.body: Victoria Wellness is focused on helping clients manage mental health issues well into the future. They prioritize physical activity in the afternoons as one of their habits and skills. They enjoy kayaking, hiking and playing tennis, as well as time at the gym, basketball and volleyball. Victoria Wellness offers evening sessions that build on morning treatments. Clients can also enjoy healthy meals that are tailored to their dietary restrictions and needs throughout their stay at Victoria Wellness.

pillars.title: Sober Fun and Restorative Amenities
pillars.body: The Victoria Wellness Centre places a high value on having fun both onsite and offsite. Clients will have access to a tranquil pool, a labyrinth and Reiki sessions. They can also fish and boat, or paddle board. Victoria Wellness offers a variety of fun and relaxing activities for clients. Clients can also take trips off-site to nearby farms, ski mountains, hiking trails and golf courses. Their fun activities promote the idea that sobriety can be enjoyable, more than the short-term pleasures that addictive substances offer.

overview: Victoria Wellness offers personalized mental health treatment programs for Anxiety, Depression, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Sexual Assault, Addictions and more. Our treatment combines evidence-based therapy in a restorative setting–providing coping skills to clients so they can lead productive and successful lives. We have an excellent year-long aftercare program, as well as, a family therapy component during care and aftercare.

location.heading: Victoria Wellness in Gores Landing, Ontario
location.intro: Victoria Wellness is on the south shore of Rice Lake in Gores Landing, a small hamlet in Northumberland County about 20 minutes north of Cobourg. Downtown Toronto is roughly an hour and a half away by car, Port Hope about 25 minutes, Peterborough around 45 minutes and Oshawa a little over an hour.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Victoria Wellness cost?
faqs.a: Victoria Wellness does not post its fees, but recovery.com estimates about $6,600 a week, or $26,400 for a four-week stay and $33,000 for five weeks. The centre says pricing depends on the program length you choose, and the client care team goes over it when you call. Extra psychotherapy time beyond the 1.5 hours a week is billed separately.

faqs.q: How long is the program at Victoria Wellness?
faqs.a: Stays are 28, 35 or 42 days. Most people start with the four-week program, and you can extend week by week for an added fee if you and your team feel you need more time.

No. Victoria Wellness says it is not a medical detox facility and asks clients to arrive sober and ready to take part. If you are still drinking or using heavily, plan a medical withdrawal program first, then come to Rice Lake for the residential stay.

faqs.q: Is Victoria Wellness a mental health centre or an addiction rehab?
faqs.a: It is mainly a residential mental health centre for adults. The centre focuses on depression, anxiety, burnout, trauma, grief and PTSD, and it also takes people with concurrent disorders and mild substance use concerns that do not need detox. Call the client care team to check whether your situation fits the program.

faqs.q: Where is Victoria Wellness and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 5316 Rice Lake Scenic Drive in Gores Landing, on the south shore of Rice Lake in Northumberland County. It is about 20 minutes north of Cobourg and roughly an hour and a half by car from downtown Toronto, mostly along Highway 401. The nearest hospital is Northumberland Hills Hospital in Cobourg.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave Victoria Wellness?
faqs.a: Follow-up sessions are booked for you after discharge: one with your primary counsellor at two weeks, one with a holistic counsellor at three weeks and one with your primary psychotherapist at a month. You can also join a weekly peer support group on Zoom for as long as you need it. Alumni can register for the free 18-week Touchstone After Care Program, which reviews the CBT, DBT and ecotherapy skills from your stay.

faqs.q: Is Victoria Wellness covered by OHIP or my benefits?
faqs.a: OHIP does not cover a stay, because Victoria Wellness is privately funded. Some services may be partly covered by extended health plans, and the centre gives itemized invoices for sessions with registered therapists that you can submit to your insurer. It also suggests getting a referral from your family doctor or mental health provider before you arrive, which can help when you claim the cost on your taxes.

faqs.q: Is Victoria Wellness accredited and licensed?
faqs.a: Yes, Victoria Wellness is fully licensed and accredited by the Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.

faqs.q: Does Victoria Wellness provide individualized treatment plans?
faqs.a: Yes, each client receives an individualized treatment plan tailored to their unique needs and goals.

faqs.q: What types of therapies are included in the addiction treatment programs at Victoria Wellness?
faqs.a: The addiction treatment programs at Victoria Wellness incorporate a range of evidence-based therapies, including cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and mindfulness-based therapy.

faqs.q: What sets Victoria Wellness apart from other rehab centers?
faqs.a: Victoria Wellness is known for its holistic approach to addiction treatment, incorporating not only evidence-based therapies, but also meditation, yoga, and physical fitness into its programs. In addition, Victoria Wellness offers a supportive and compassionate environment where clients can feel safe and supported throughout their recovery journey.

faqs.q: What amenities are available at Victoria Wellness rehab center?
faqs.a: Victoria Wellness offers air-conditioned rooms, bathroom essentials, fitness center, gardens, housekeeping, outdoor space, private/shared rooms, recreation room, TV, theater, view, and walking trails.

faqs.q: What aftercare programs are available at Victoria Wellness rehab center?
faqs.a: Victoria Wellness offers an excellent year-long aftercare program, family follow-up counseling, recovery coach, and support meetings.
